etymology.historical_story: Augie is documented as an English nickname for August. A familiar literary bearer is the narrator of Saul Bellow's The Adventures of Augie March, first published in 1953. That example establishes a cultural use of the name, but it does not identify the lowercase token in this packet or establish an ordinary Malay meaning. [Name reference](https://www.behindthename.com/name/augie), [Publisher's account](https://www.penguinrandomhouse.com/books/323605/the-adventures-of-augie-march-by-saul-bellow/)
